lead.description: a level-by-level listing of frequent item sets that skips any set with an infrequent subset

agrawal_srikant1994.title: Fast Algorithms for Mining Association Rules
agrawal_srikant1994.venue: Proceedings of the 20th International Conference on Very Large Data Bases

overview_sentence: The [Apriori algorithm](articles/apriori-algorithm.qmd) lists frequent item sets by discarding any set whose subset is already infrequent.
